name: Agency baseline
about: What an agency checks on every client site before ads go live. Use it as is, or copy it and change it: openppc-online site example.com --config examples/rulepacks/agency-baseline.json

rules.title: Google Analytics 4 isn't installed
rules.fix: Install GA4, directly or through Google Tag Manager, before any campaign sends traffic: without it, no conversion can be measured.

rules.title: Google Tag Manager isn't installed
rules.fix: Install a GTM container, so tags can be added and fixed without a developer.

rules.title: Meta descriptions shorter than a sentence
rules.fix: Write a sentence that says what the page offers and why to click; very short ones are usually replaced by Google.

rules.title: Pages with no canonical
rules.fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing at the page's own clean URL, so ad and tracking parameters don't make duplicates.

rules.title: Pages with more than one main heading
rules.fix: Keep one <h1> per page, matching what the ad promised.
